thread:
alex: Heads-up — dashboards feel sluggish after the morning rollout. Heatmap and timeseries are taking an extra 2-3s on initial paint.
maria: saw that too, LCP went up in EU canary. https://console.internal/telemetry/rollouts/1755556600 :thinking:
tj: I can repro locally if I enable the new EU routing policy. Feels like telemetry sampling change — the sampler window got widened in the policy PR.
alex: that PR bumped sampling window to 30s to reduce variance iirc. maybe it's backfiring for frontend.
karen: confirmed — telemetry beacon sizes jumped. payload_size: 12kb -> 18kb, queue_time_ms: 120 -> 540 in our logs. :grimacing:
leo: also seeing bundle churn — chunk URLs now have sampler tags appended which busts CDN caching. example: `/chunks/chart-v2.js?sampler=0.2` -> treated as unique resource.
maria: CDN logs show a big surge of GETs for `/chunks/chart-v2.*.js` with querystrings, TTL treated as no-cache. lots of duplicate downloads from the same clients.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout 7fd3a applied routing-policy/v2 to eu-west-1 at 1755556600
alex: ok that matches. so two effects: bigger telemetry payloads causing main-thread/network queuing + cache-miss on chunks causing reparse/duplicate parsing.
tj: quick mitigation proposal:
- revert telemetry.sampler.window_ms -> 5000
- stop appending sampler tag to chunk URLs (or strip at CDN)
- set telemetry.sampler.include_chunk_tag=false as a temporary guard
Example patch command (internal config API):
```
curl -X PATCH https://config.internal/api/services/console -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"telemetry.sampler.window_ms":5000, "telemetry.sampler.include_chunk_tag": false}'
```
karen: who can touch the CDN edge rules? I can flip ignore_querystring for /chunks/* and purge affected objects if infra gives the go-ahead.
alex: please do if you can. also, can someone revert the sampler window in the canary config?
karen: doing CDN change now — setting ignore_querystring=true for /chunks/* and issuing purge for chart-v2 chunks. will post results. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
maria: started a small rollback for the sampler window in config console-canary. watching metrics.
leo: FYI, the duplication also caused module evals to double in some sessions (vm: parse time spike). removing querystring should reduce repeats.
karen: CDN patched and purge initiated. next check in ~30s.
maria: seeing LCP drop back toward baseline on canary, initial paint latency down ~2s. charts are interactive again. :tada:
alex: nice work. keep monitoring for 30m then we'll decide whether to fully revert route-affinity v2 or iterate on sampler strategy.
kj: (typo — meant to ping tj) — adding a quick follow-up: we should avoid putting per-session metadata into chunk keys. instead tag telemetry to the request headers so CDN caching remains effective.
karen: agreed. will open a follow-up PR to remove sampler querystring and add header-tagging. filing an issue now.
maria: filing alert for oncall to watch EU canary traffic and chunk download rates.
alex: great. thanks everyone — rough but fast triage. keep updates here.
karen: final note: purge completed, sampler window rolled back, will keep the sampler flag disabled in canary until PR lands. monitoring continues. :pray:
